step_4_life_story_and_interests.occupation: Retired District Agriculture Officer & Angami Folklore Custodian
step_4_life_story_and_interests.favorite_music_or_artists: Traditional Naga folk chants (Li), choral Christian hymns, acoustic guitar melodies.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.cultural_background: Angami Naga community; celebrates Sekrenyi purification festival and Hornbill Festival; wears traditional red-black woven shawl.
step_4_life_story_and_interests.what_brings_them_joy: Tending his terrace vegetable garden in Midland, looking at carved wooden Hornbill artefacts, and telling tribal stories to his granddaughter.
